BUSINESS TRANSPARENCY
Clear service terms, responsible auto care

FairLink Auto Care is an independent multi-brand vehicle service provider. Every repair begins with customer approval and a transparent estimate.

01
18+ Booking Policy

Bookings and approvals must be placed by customers aged 18 years or older, or by an authorised vehicle representative.

02
Estimate Before Work

Inspection findings and estimated charges are shared before paid work begins. Additional repairs require separate approval.

03
Invoices & Payments

Final charges depend on the approved job scope, vehicle condition and parts used. Customers receive a service invoice.

04
Parts & Warranty

Parts availability and warranty coverage vary by manufacturer and service type. Applicable terms appear on the invoice.

05
Privacy & Communication

Customer details are used only for enquiries, pickup coordination, service updates and support. Never share passwords or one-time codes.

06
Independent Workshop

FairLink is not an authorised dealership unless explicitly stated. Brand names only describe vehicles we can service.
